Training stage evidence is internally consistent and well-documented. Key verifications pass: (1) Cosine LR schedule is mathematically correct across all 15 epochs (lr=0.001→0.0, verified at epochs 1, 10, 15). (2) Train loss monotonically decreases (0.695→0.499); val accuracy rises to 0.997001 at epoch 15; early stopping (patience=3) correctly did not trigger since epoch 15 was the best. (3) Augmented train size 359984 = 89996×4 is consistent with augmentation_factor=4. (4) Normalization stats are in [0,1] unit range, sourced from train only. (5) Checkpoint provenance (path + sha256) is present. (6) test_metrics_used=false confirms no test-set leakage into selection.

Minor observations (non-blocking): (a) best_configuration.validation_accuracy=0.982707 differs from train_result.best_val_accuracy=0.997001 (~1.4 pp gap). This is likely attributable to the selection phase using a different evaluation protocol (e.g., fewer epochs, different seed, or a subsampled validation slice) versus the full 15-epoch final run, but the rationale is not explicitly stated in the artefact. Recommend a one-line note in the run manifest clarifying the provenance of the 0.982707 figure. (b) LLM-generated prose in ambiguity_risks repeatedly references '96×96 patch resolution' while structured data correctly reports image_shape_hwc=[28,28,3]; this is a prose-only inconsistency with no impact on training. (c) llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama), limiting full reproducibility of narrative steps; structured training data is unaffected. (d) Test-set class imbalance (debris n=339, stroma n=421) will yield noisy per-class metrics; already documented.

No deterministic findings. All structured data is self-consistent. Proceed to next stage.
llm_issues: best_configuration.validation_accuracy (0.982707) and train_result.best_val_accuracy (0.997001) differ by ~1.4 pp without an explicit note explaining the different evaluation contexts (selection trial vs final run); recommend documenting the provenance of the selection-phase metric.
LLM narrative in ambiguity_risks references '96×96 patch resolution' but actual image_shape_hwc is [28,28,3]; prose-only factual inconsistency, structured data is correct.
llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama); exact model weights not pinned by content hash, limiting full reproducibility of LLM-dependent narrative steps.

Test-set class distribution deviates substantially from train/val (adipose ×1.79, debris ×0.41, stroma ×0.56); per-class test metrics for debris (n=339), stroma (n=421), smooth muscle (n=592) will be statistically noisy — properly documented but worth monitoring downstream.
